description: This file defines an interface for device registration write operations within the Fineract project, including methods to register, update, and delete device registrations.

classes.name: DeviceRegistrationWritePlatformService
classes.description: Interface providing methods for registering, updating, and deleting device registrations for clients.

methods.name: registerDevice
methods.description: Registers a new device for a client with the given registration ID.

methods.name: updateDeviceRegistration
methods.description: Updates an existing device registration identified by its ID and client ID.

methods.name: deleteDeviceRegistration
methods.description: Deletes a device registration identified by its ID.
